evidence_class: parameter-localization development on all previously inspected positive examples; not fresh confirmation

population.rule: The exact same 866 positive examples and target-excluded prototype tensor as Days 45-46; no omission, rescaling, subgroup selection, or recomputation is permitted.
population.weighting: equal directions within example, equal examples within concept, equal concepts for every primary macro

matched_control.selection_rule: Lexicographically earliest query heads disjoint from K12 that exactly match the per-layer query-head count and unique grouped-query key/value-head count; key/value heads are the induced query_head // 2 set and are disjoint from selected key/value heads.

causal_estimands.natural_effect_recovery: For each hybrid state, projection of the hybrid natural-K12 total-path 13-probe effect onto the same-example/direction Chameleon natural-K12 effect, divided by squared Chameleon effect norm.
causal_estimands.fixed_prototype_effect_recovery: Projection of the frozen-prototype effect under the hybrid state onto its same-example/direction Chameleon-parameter prototype effect, divided by squared Chameleon prototype-effect norm.
causal_estimands.trajectory_recovery: Projection of the hybrid selected-head triggered-minus-normal raw trajectory onto the same-example Chameleon trajectory, divided by squared Chameleon trajectory norm, over response tokens and selected heads.
causal_estimands.selectivity_advantage: Matched-control natural-effect recovery minus selected natural-effect recovery for the same parameter scope; positive values mean larger loss for K12-selected parameters.
causal_estimands.weight_difference_norms: Descriptive only; never a causal gate.

execution.dtype: bfloat16 model execution and float32 effects
execution.upstream_control: Layers 0-8 and each condition's layer-9 input remain the Chameleon computation; layer-9 inputs must be bit-identical across every parameter state.
execution.batch_order: concept, then response token count, then example_id
execution.resumption: atomic batch shards containing every state before the shard is complete

signature_rules.acquired_write_geometry: selected_o is material and selected_o fixed-prototype effect recovery is <= 0.8
signature_rules.acquired_query_routing: selected_q is material, selected_q trajectory recovery is <= 0.8, and selected_q fixed-prototype effect recovery is >= 0.8
signature_rules.acquired_key_value_routing: selected_kv is material, selected_kv trajectory recovery is <= 0.8, and selected_kv fixed-prototype effect recovery is >= 0.8
signature_rules.qkv_coadaptation: selected_qkv is material while neither selected_q nor selected_kv is material, and selected_qkv recovery is at least 0.15 below both selected_q and selected_kv
signature_rules.complete_attention_coadaptation: selected_qkvo is material and its recovery is at least 0.15 below both selected_o and selected_qkv
signature_rules.local_selected_parameters_insufficient: selected_qkvo is not material or selected_qkvo natural-effect recovery is >= 0.8

disposition.one_or_more_local_signatures: Report every passing signature and advance only the implicated parameter group(s) to a separately frozen finer localization.
disposition.no_local_signature: Stop local selected-slice attribution and retain the operational K12 write with upstream or more distributed implementation unresolved.

scope_boundary: No scale, head set, precursor, parameter family, threshold, concept handling, fresh data, behavior endpoint, or finer swap may change after outcomes.
